title: The Guidance of the Spirit
sourceBasis: World English Bible — 66-book Old and New Testament Scripture text already installed in Iron Sharpener
definition: The guidance of the Spirit is the work by which the Holy Spirit leads God’s people in truth, wisdom, obedience, and dependence on Christ. His guidance agrees with Scripture and never leads into sin or falsehood.
summary: The guidance of the Spirit is the work by which the Holy Spirit leads God’s people in truth, wisdom, obedience, and dependence on Christ. His guidance agrees with Scripture and never leads into sin or falsehood.
christFocus: The Spirit guides believers toward the will and ways of Christ. He leads them to trust the Savior, obey His Word, walk in holiness, and serve His mission.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Those who are led by the Spirit are children of God. His guidance is not merely about decisions, locations, or timing, but about a whole life brought under God’s truth and lordship.

The Spirit guides into truth. He does not contradict Scripture, flatter the flesh, or excuse disobedience. His leading is holy, wise, and Christ-centered.

In the life of the church, the Spirit directed mission and service. His guidance works through prayer, Scripture, wisdom, godly counsel, providence, and obedience to what God has already revealed.

Believers must seek guidance with humility. Not every impression, desire, opportunity, or emotion is the Spirit’s leading. Everything must be tested by God’s Word.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
Many people want guidance but resist obedience. They ask God for direction while ignoring clear commands. The Spirit’s guidance is not a shortcut around Scripture; it is help to walk faithfully in God’s truth.

This doctrine brings peace to believers who feel confused or afraid. God does not abandon His children to themselves. He leads them with wisdom as they trust Him.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Seek the Spirit’s guidance through Scripture, prayer, obedience, and wise counsel. Do not mistake impulse for holiness or desire for direction. Submit your plans to God, obey what is already clear, and trust the Spirit to lead you in ways that honor Christ.
